# Review pack: review-dependency-management

Everything a worker needs for this skill, in one file: `SKILL.md`, `references/checklist.md`, the skill's other reference files and its language-neutral standards. Language-specific standards and signals are in `packs/review-dependency-management.<language>.md`. Where the instructions below say to load one of these files, use its section here instead; don't open the original. Citation columns (anchors, pages, source names) are left out: cite an element by its ID in `Finding.element` and the report script fills in `standard` and `url`. `sources.md` is maintainer material and is not included.

## File: `SKILL.md`

### Review: Dependency Management

Assesses how third-party dependencies are declared, pinned, sourced, scanned and kept on supported versions,
using local, pinned summaries of OWASP supply-chain guidance and vendor lifecycle data.

#### Inputs

Dependency manifests, lock files, central package files, package-source config (`nuget.config`, `pip.conf`,
`.npmrc`, Maven `settings.xml`), runtime pins (`global.json`, `.python-version`, `runtime.txt`, `.nvmrc`,
`.node-version`), dependency-update
config (Dependabot/Renovate), scanner suppression files, SBOM files and `02-analyzers.json` (if present),
per `compliance-inventory`.

#### Standards (local, authoritative)

- `references/standards/owasp-supply-chain.md` — OTT-01…OTT-09, OCS-01…OCS-15. Always load.
- `references/standards/lifecycle-dotnet.md` — NET-01…06, NFX-01…05. Load when language `csharp` is detected.
- `references/standards/lifecycle-java.md` — JDK-01…08, SPR-01…07. Load when language `java` is detected.
- `references/standards/lifecycle-python.md` — PY-01…07. Load when language `python` is detected.
- `references/standards/lifecycle-javascript.md` — NODE-01…05, EXP-01. Load when language `javascript` is detected.
- Do **not** fetch any URL for this skill, and never use remembered CVE, end-of-life or license facts.
  Do not load `references/standards/MAINTENANCE.md`.
- If no element covers a situation: apply the closest element if it clearly fits; otherwise mark the check N/A
  ("not covered by localized standard") and add `localized-standard-gap: <description>` to `notes`.

#### Procedure

1. Load `references/checklist.md`, `references/sources.md`, the OWASP file and the lifecycle file(s) for the detected
   languages. A `generic`-only target loads no lifecycle file; DEP-04 is then N/A ("no localized lifecycle data for
   detected languages").
2. Reference date = the date part of the `startedAt` header value you were given.
3. For each active check (DEP-01…DEP-05, DEP-07…DEP-09; DEP-06 is retired and is not written to `checkResults`),
   evaluate the elements it lists against the subject's files. Mark the check N/A with a reason when no element
   applies (e.g. DEP-02 for Maven-only targets; DEP-07 when no update/scanning config is in the file list).
4. DEP-03 (analyzer-only): use only vulnerability entries in `02-analyzers.json` (result keys `dotnet-vulnerable`,
   `pip-audit`, `maven-dependency-check`, `gradle-dependency-check`). If there are none, mark DEP-03 N/A
   ("no vulnerability analyzer output for this run"). One finding per package + advisory; evidence is the declaring
   manifest line (or the direct dependency for a transitive package), with the advisory id in the excerpt; cite
   OTT-09 (or OCS-03), not the CVE. Severity: Critical/High → Error, Moderate/Medium → Warning, Low → Information,
   none reported → Error. DEP-09 (OTT-08) may cite `dotnet-deprecated` entries as evidence of deprecated packages;
   `dotnet-outdated` entries are context only (an older but supported version is not a finding by itself).
5. DEP-04 (date rule): find each declared runtime/framework target and its lifecycle row. `YYYY-MM` dates mean the
   last day of that month. Support end before the reference date → finding (Error). Within 180 days after it → pass,
   and add `eol-approaching: <product> <line> on <date>` to `notes`. "With the host OS" lines pass. Multi-targeting:
   one finding per EOL target (`netstandard*` is never EOL). Version ranges: fail only if the highest permitted
   version is EOL; a lower bound below the oldest supported line adds `eol-lower-bound: <range>` to `notes`.
   With Spring Boot, evaluate Boot, not the Framework it manages (unless the manifest overrides the Framework
   version). `Microsoft.AspNetCore.*`/`EntityFrameworkCore.*`/`Extensions.*` at major N follow .NET N (NET-06).
   Pre-release lines aren't EOL; a production manifest targeting one fails DEP-09 instead.
   A line newer than every row → N/A + `localized-standard-gap: <product> <line> not in lifecycle snapshot <date>`.
   If the reference date is more than 9 months after a lifecycle file's "Localized" date, add
   `localized-standard-stale: <file> localized <date>` to `notes`.
6. Evidence rule: fail a practice element only on concrete evidence in the files (floating version, `http://` feed,
   pre-release version in production scope, missing lock file where the ecosystem supports one). Don't fail on
   speculation. Use confidence `medium` unless the evidence is unambiguous.
7. Severity: practice elements take the check's default from `checklist.md`, except that a plain-`http://` package
   source or unmapped mixed public/private feeds is Error. `checkResults.severityIfFailed` is the check's default.
8. Citations: set `element` to the failed element's ID (e.g. `OTT-02`); the report script derives `standard` and `url`
   from it, so don't write them.
9. Boundaries: **owned here** — vulnerable or outdated library versions, through analyzer output only (DEP-03);
   EOL runtimes and frameworks (DEP-04); pinning (DEP-01); lock files (DEP-02, sole owner); SBOM (DEP-05); update
   automation (DEP-07); manifest-referenced binaries (DEP-08); test-only packages in production dependency scope
   (DEP-09). **Don't fail for** CI/CD workflow hardening, action/image pinning in workflows, provenance or signing
   (review-software-lifecycle SL-05, SL-09, SL-10); committed binaries not referenced by a manifest (SL-12); unsafe
   *use* of parsers, serializers or loggers (review-security-input-injection, review-security-operational); install
   commands and download-and-execute in CI (SL-10, OSC-13); licence files (review-maintainability MAINT-10).
   Without analyzer output, vulnerable versions of libraries such as XStream, fastjson, Kryo, SnakeYAML, Expat or
   Log4j 2 aren't reported by any skill (accepted consequence of plan DEC-2); add `no-analyzer-output` to `notes`.

#### Output

Findings, strengths and check results per `compliance-review-core`'s `finding-schema.md`.

### Checklist — Dependency Management

Subject: Dependency Management

Elements are defined in `standards/` (OTT/OCS in `owasp-supply-chain.md`; NET/NFX in `lifecycle-dotnet.md`;
JDK/SPR in `lifecycle-java.md`; PY in `lifecycle-python.md`; NODE/EXP in `lifecycle-javascript.md`). Every element belongs to exactly one active check.
DEP-06 is retired: don't evaluate it or write it to `checkResults`, and never reuse the ID.

| id | Sub-subject | Check | Default severity | Elements | Source |
|----|-------------|-------|------------------|----------|--------|
| DEP-01 | Dependency Management | Dependencies and build tooling are pinned to exact or narrow versions; nothing floats (`*`, `latest`, `+`, `LATEST`/`RELEASE`, unbounded `>=`) | Warning | OTT-07, OCS-11, OCS-15 | OTT, OCS |
| DEP-02 | Dependency Management | A lock file capturing the transitive graph exists in the repository files where the ecosystem supports one (`packages.lock.json` with `RestorePackagesWithLockFile`, `poetry.lock`, `uv.lock`, `Pipfile.lock`, hashed `requirements.txt`, `gradle.lockfile`); N/A for Maven-only targets (Maven has no native lock file) | Warning | OTT-01, OCS-12 | OTT, OCS |
| DEP-03 | Dependency Management | No analyzer-reported vulnerability is left unremediated or covered by a bare suppression (analyzer-only; N/A without analyzer output) | Error | OTT-09, OCS-02, OCS-03, OCS-05 | OTT, OCS |
| DEP-04 | Dependency Management | No declared runtime or framework target is past its vendor support-end date | Error | OTT-02, NET-01…06, NFX-01…05, JDK-01…08, SPR-01…07, PY-01…07, NODE-01…05, EXP-01 | OTT, vendor lifecycle |
| DEP-05 | Dependency Management | An SBOM is present or generated by the build (`*.cdx.json`, `*.spdx.json`, `sbom.json`, CycloneDX/SPDX plugin or tool configured) | Information | OTT-04, OCS-09 | OTT, OCS |
| DEP-06 | — | *(retired 2026-11-07: license compatibility; ID not reused)* | — | — | — |
| DEP-07 | Dependency Management | Automated dependency update and vulnerability scanning are configured (Dependabot/Renovate, NuGetAudit, scanner config), and any suppressions are scoped to a single CVE with a recorded reason | Warning | OTT-03, OCS-01, OCS-04, OCS-07, OCS-10 | OTT, OCS |
| DEP-08 | Dependency Management | Packages come only from trusted sources over HTTPS through a feed setup that can't be bypassed (source mapping / single mirror), with signature or hash verification where supported, and no vendored binaries | Warning (Error for `http://` or unmapped mixed feeds) | OTT-06, OCS-06, OCS-13, OCS-14 | OTT, OCS |
| DEP-09 | Dependency Management | Production dependencies are released, maintained versions: no pre-release versions or runtime lines, no analyzer-reported deprecated packages, no test/dev-only packages in production scope | Warning | OTT-05, OTT-08, OCS-08 | OTT, OCS |

## File: `references/standards/owasp-supply-chain.md`

*Load rule: OTT-01…OTT-09, OCS-01…OCS-15. Always load.*

### OWASP software supply chain guidance — localized summary

- Level: every element is `REVIEW` (these sections use no normative keywords); severity is the owning check's default.

#### A03:2025 Software Supply Chain Failures (OTT)

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Manifest/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OTT-01 | REVIEW | Track and continuously inventory the versions of all components, including nested (transitive) dependencies. | lock file capturing the transitive graph | DEP-02 |
| OTT-02 | REVIEW | Components, runtime environments and frameworks must not be unsupported or out of date. | declared runtime/framework target | DEP-04 |
| OTT-03 | REVIEW | Scan for vulnerabilities regularly; automate it with software composition analysis and subscribe to alerts. | Dependabot/Renovate config, NuGetAudit, scanner config | DEP-07 |
| OTT-04 | REVIEW | Centrally generate and manage an SBOM for the software. | SBOM file or SBOM-generator plugin/task | DEP-05 |
| OTT-05 | REVIEW | Reduce attack surface by removing unused dependencies and unnecessary components. | test/dev-only packages in production scope; duplicate declarations | DEP-09 |
| OTT-06 | REVIEW | Obtain components only from official, trusted sources over secure links; prefer signed packages. Untrusted sources must not reach production. | feed/index/repository URLs, signature-validation settings | DEP-08 |
| OTT-07 | REVIEW | Deliberately choose which version of a dependency is used, and upgrade only when there's a need. | exact or narrow versions; no `*`, `latest`, `+`, `LATEST`, `RELEASE` | DEP-01 |
| OTT-08 | REVIEW | Monitor for unmaintained libraries or ones without security patches for older lines; migrate if patching isn't possible. | analyzer "deprecated"/"outdated" output | DEP-09 |
| OTT-09 | REVIEW | Fix or upgrade vulnerable platforms, frameworks and dependencies in a risk-based, timely way. | analyzer vulnerability output | DEP-03 |

#### OWASP Cheat Sheets (OCS)

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Manifest/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OCS-01 | REVIEW | Run automated dependency analysis from the start of the project, not as a late add-on. | scanning configured in repo | DEP-07 |
| OCS-02 | REVIEW | Remediate a vulnerable transitive dependency through the direct dependency that pulls it in. | direct dependency of the reported package | DEP-03 |
| OCS-03 | REVIEW | When a patched version exists, update to it and validate with automated tests. | analyzer "fixed in" vs declared version | DEP-03 |
| OCS-04 | REVIEW | A risk acceptance or suppression is scoped to the specific CVE (never the whole package) and documented with its reason. | suppression/ignore files (`NuGetAuditSuppress`, `--ignore-vuln`, dependency-check suppressions, `.trivyignore`) | DEP-07 |
| OCS-05 | REVIEW | Suppressing an alert, or changing a version string so a tool stops matching, isn't a fix. An in-house patch is verified by a failing-then-passing test. | suppression with no fix or justification | DEP-03 |
| OCS-06 | REVIEW | Patched or backported artifacts are published to the internal registry with a traceable version and provenance, not committed as local binaries. | `<HintPath>` to repo-local DLLs, Maven `system` scope, vendored wheels/JARs | DEP-08 |
| OCS-07 | REVIEW | The detection tool uses several reliable vulnerability sources and supports flagging false positives. | scanner choice/config | DEP-07 |
| OCS-08 | REVIEW | Prefer released, actively maintained components: no alpha/beta/pre-release versions; the project keeps its own dependencies updated. | `-alpha`/`-beta`/`-rc`/`-preview`/`-SNAPSHOT`, PEP 440 `aN`/`bN`/`rcN`/`.devN` in production scope | DEP-09 |
| OCS-09 | REVIEW | Inventory production and development dependencies, e.g. with an SBOM. | SBOM file or generator | DEP-05 |
| OCS-10 | REVIEW | Monitor dependencies for known vulnerabilities automatically (NVD, OSV, CISA KEV). | scanner/advisory automation | DEP-07 |
| OCS-11 | REVIEW | Limit dependencies to specific, previously verified versions. | exact pins / narrow ranges | DEP-01 |
| OCS-12 | REVIEW | Use a lock file so builds resolve the exact, previously verified versions. | lock file present and committed | DEP-02 |
| OCS-13 | REVIEW | Use a private artifact repository whose use can't be bypassed. | single feed with `<clear/>`, NuGet package source mapping, pip `index-url` only, Maven mirror `*` | DEP-08 |
| OCS-14 | REVIEW | Accept only signed components and validate signatures before use. | NuGet `signatureValidationMode=require` / `trustedSigners`; pip `--require-hashes` | DEP-08 |
| OCS-15 | REVIEW | Inventory build tools, including versions and plugins. | SDK pin (`global.json`), Maven plugin versions, Gradle plugin versions, `build-system.requires` pins | DEP-01 |
